title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: reserve a free room on the spot from the console
summary: The briefing passes: the room setting, role-assignment route, Pro licensing and release dates agree with Microsoft's sources. The Canada time-zone workaround is documented, and targeted searches did not find documentation resolving the stated default, automation or reservation-detail gaps.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Teams Rooms on Windows consoles let room users book the room for immediate use.
claims.quote: With Teams Rooms on Windows consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A Reserve button appears on the room calendar when the room is available.
claims.quote: A **Reserve** button appears on the calendar when the room is available.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes immediate room booking as helping avoid scheduling conflicts so spontaneous meetings are not interrupted.
claims.quote: helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings.

claims.claim: Ad-hoc room reservation is included with Teams Rooms Pro and is marked with the Pro-only feature icon in the release notes.
claims.quote:

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Teams Rooms Basic does not entitle a room to this Pro-only feature; the room needs Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: If a feature isn't available for a license, that feature can't be used on Teams Rooms devices that have been assigned that license. To use a feature on a Teams Rooms device, assign the license in which that feature is available to that device.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; summary; What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The per-room Windows toggle is at Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Meetings > Allow ad hoc room reservation.
claims.quote: On **Teams Rooms on Windows** devices: open the Pro Management Portal > **Rooms** > select your room > **Settings** > **Meetings** > toggle **Allow ad hoc room reservation** to control this functionality.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API or command that sets the Windows ad-hoc room reservation toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams PowerShell module ad hoc room reservation Teams Rooms Windows console settings; "Teams Rooms on Windows" "reservation" "PowerShell" "Graph". Read mtr-home-refresh, xml-config-file and Graph teamworkFeaturesConfiguration; no matching operation.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether Allow ad hoc room reservation starts on or off on Windows.
claims.quote: Searched: "Allow ad hoc room reservation" "default". Read roadmap record, mtr-home-refresh, rooms-release-note, device-settings-available and xml-config-file. None states the Windows toggle's default; the default found for Teams panels is a different feature.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms on Android also has ad-hoc room reservation.
claims.quote: On **Teams Rooms on Android** devices: open **Teams Admin Settings** > **Meetings** and toggle **Allow ad hoc room reservation**

claims.claim: The Android device setting is Teams Admin Settings > Meetings > Allow ad hoc room reservation.
claims.quote: On **Teams Rooms on Android** devices: open **Teams Admin Settings** > **Meetings** and toggle **Allow ad hoc room reservation**

claims.claim: The Android setting can also be controlled through a Teams admin center configuration profile.
claims.quote: toggle **Allow ad hoc room reservation** to toggle this functionality or use the configuration profile within Teams Admin Center.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Immediate console bookings reserve the room on its calendar alongside scheduled room meetings.
claims.quote:
The room calendar on **Teams Rooms (Windows and Android)** devices shows the room availability and scheduled meetings in the room
Allow users to quickly book the meeting room for immediate use

claims.claim: Microsoft describes booking the current room but no new data reach for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "ad hoc room reservation" default enabled duration organizer identity calendar processing bulk settings templates PowerShell. Read mtr-home-refresh and rooms-release-note; the feature description names only booking the meeting room.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented which account appears as organiser of a Windows console reservation.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "ad hoc room reservation" default enabled duration organizer identity calendar processing bulk settings templates PowerShell. Read mtr-home-refresh and rooms-release-note; neither identifies the console reservation's recorded organiser.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described which identity creates a Windows console reservation.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "ad hoc room reservation" default enabled duration organizer identity calendar processing bulk settings templates PowerShell. Read mtr-home-refresh, rooms-release-note and resource-account search excerpts; no console reservation creation identity is stated.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how long a Windows console reservation lasts.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "ad hoc room reservation" default enabled duration organizer identity calendar processing bulk settings templates PowerShell. Read mtr-home-refresh and rooms-release-note. Duration instructions found for Teams panels do not describe Windows console reservations.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether Exchange calendar processing settings govern reservations made at the Windows console.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms ad hoc room reservation Exchange calendar processing. Read mtr-home-refresh and create-resource-account mailbox-property search excerpts. They describe calendar customisations and processing meeting invitations, not how console reservations are created or processed.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft lists a Windows ad-hoc reservation issue with the new British Columbia, Alberta and Manitoba time zones.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms on Windows devices should automatically pickup new Windows time zones "**British Columbia Standard Time**, **Albert Standard Time**, and **Manitoba Standard Time** however, ad-hoc room reservation may not correctly adjust to these time zones.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Temporarily disabling ad-hoc reservation through Pro Management settings is Microsoft's documented workaround.
claims.quote: Temporarily disable ad-hoc room reservation using [Settings Management in the Pro Management Portal](/en-us/microsoftteams/rooms/pro-portal-settings)

claims.claim: Configuring an alternative time zone on the console is also a documented workaround.
claims.quote: or [configure alternative time zones](/en-us/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-operations#changing-the-teams-rooms-console-language-or-date--time-format) as a workaround until the region specific time zone is resolved

claims.claim: Apply Now queues the setting change and restarts the device as soon as possible.
claims.quote: **Apply Now** - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Schedule Later schedules the setting change for the nightly maintenance window.
claims.quote: **Schedule Later** - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: The deployment overview says the Pro Management portal can be enabled once the tenant has a Teams Rooms Pro licence.
claims.quote: Once you have a Teams Rooms Pro license available in your Microsoft 365 tenant, you can enable the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal

claims.claim: Portal settings management applies only to signed-in devices.
claims.quote: **Settings management is available only for signed-in devices.** Ensure that the device is signed in for settings changes from the Teams Rooms Pro management portal to be applied successfully.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope: Who configures it; Governance controls
claims.claim: Changing device settings in the Pro Management portal requires RBAC permissions for room management.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones), provided you have the necessary role-based access control permissions for Rooms Management.

claims.claim: Portal role assignments are reached through Settings > Roles > role > Assignments > Add assignment > General settings > Members > Scope.
claims.quote:
expand **Settings** > **Roles**.
Select the role you want to assign.
In the role pane, select **Assignments** > **Add assignment**.
On the **General settings** page
On the **Members** page
On the **Scope** page

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for the portal's room-scoped role assignments.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms Pro Management" "role" "assignment" API PowerShell Graph automation; portal custom roles automation PowerShell API Site Lead Site Technician assignment. Read rooms-pro-rbac; no automation for portal assignments was found.

claims.claim: Assigning portal roles requires Global Administrator, tenant-wide Teams Administrator, Teams Rooms Pro Manager or a custom role with role management permissions.
claims.quote: To assign roles, you must be a Global Administrator/ Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager role or have a custom role with role management permissions.

claims.claim: Portal role assignments can be scoped to rooms or room groups.
claims.quote: On the **Scope** page, in the **Search for room or room group** box, type the name of either a room or room group that the user will be allowed to manage.

claims.claim: Creating portal roles requires Global Administrator, tenant-wide Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager.
claims.quote: To create a role, you must be a Global Administrator/ Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager role.

claims.claim: Editing portal roles requires Global Administrator, tenant-wide Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager.
claims.quote:
To create, edit, or assign roles, your account must have one of the following permissions:
- Global Administrator or Teams Administrator through Microsoft Entra ID.
- Teams Rooms Pro Manager through the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: The Teams Administrator permission route must not be limited to an administrative unit.
claims.quote: Teams Administrator or Teams Devices Administrator assigned to an Administrative Unit (AU), can't access the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, as AUs aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: The portal supports device settings jobs for bulk configuration changes.
claims.quote: You can change settings on a single device, or for many devices at once using **Device setting jobs**.

claims.claim: Settings templates provide reusable configurations for assigned devices or groups.
claims.quote:
Settings templates let you define a named, reusable configuration that is assigned to specific devices or device groups.
**Navigate to:** Settings > **Device settings** page > **Templates (Preview)** tab

claims.claim: The remote-management settings list does not include Allow ad hoc room reservation as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: reservation and ad.hoc in the fetched device-settings-available?tabs=WindowsSettings page. No matching entry; the Windows Meetings table lists other settings and distinguishes individual from bulk availability.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed bulk application of the Windows ad-hoc reservation toggle through settings jobs or templates.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "ad hoc room reservation" default enabled duration organizer identity calendar processing bulk settings templates PowerShell. Read mtr-home-refresh, pro-portal-settings and device-settings-available; no feature-specific bulk support statement was found.

claims.claim: Microsoft no longer publishes new XML settings and recommends the Pro Management portal instead.
claims.quote: We recommend using the individual and bulk settings configuration options within the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal instead of the XML configuration. We no longer publish new XML settings but all settings are managable within the Portal.

claims.claim: There is no documented XML configuration setting for Windows ad-hoc room reservation.
claims.quote: Searched: reservation and ad.hoc throughout the fetched xml-config-file page, plus Teams PowerShell module ad hoc room reservation Teams Rooms Windows console settings. No XML element for this feature was found.

claims.claim: The Graph teamworkFeaturesConfiguration reference documents no ad-hoc room reservation property.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms on Windows" "reservation" "PowerShell" "Graph". Read the entire beta teamworkFeaturesConfiguration reference: its five properties cover logs/feedback, screen sharing, Bluetooth and hiding meeting names, not reservation.

claims.claim: For rooms already licensed with Teams Rooms Pro, this feature is included rather than requiring a further licence.
claims.quote:
Features with the ![](../media/mtr-pro-icon.png) icon are available only with Teams Rooms Pro license.
**Ad-hoc room reservation**![](../media/mtr-pro-icon.png)

claims.claim: The portal's settings templates tab is labelled preview.
claims.quote: **Navigate to:** Settings > **Device settings** page > **Templates (Preview)** tab

claims.claim: Teams Rooms has meeting-name privacy settings.
claims.quote: For privacy purposes, meeting names can be hidden from **Teams Rooms (Windows and Android)** calendar and replaced with the organizer name if desired

claims.claim: This roadmap item concerns Teams Rooms on Windows, not the Android version of the capability.
